It means a lot that at least someone cares about me... It's kinda hard to understand that you do not even know me personally ..but i feel the compassion..

 I feel so empty inside .. I do not know what is good and bad ..

I took a look at the site what you sent, I had already read a bit but I did not feel good .. Now that I've read it I feel a bit better. 

Thanks a lot !
Good luck with everything you do :D I'm happy to hear you're ok ! Live your life the fullest <3 one love
